title: Suden, unexpected battery draining on Galaxy Wat 4 with AAPS custom watchface?
body:
**AAPS Custom Watchface**
_AAPS dev build build, commit#d20beee8914e7938266b30a4bf6cff71f5a108a8 (nov 24)

Since latest dev build of nov 24, experiencing sudden/unexpected battery draining on my Samsung Galaxy watch 4 running AAPS Custom watchface. In general I used to get 24 hrs of use out of one charge. This went down to about 12 hours, depleting the battery to 0%?

Problem started since updating to laste dev build of nov 24.
Last know good build, commit# 6de44f967548843c61490d7c2c811c321e2ff3ec (nov 22)

Still investigating: have no way of telling the problem is in AAPS. Could this be related to the new svg.json endpoint?

Anyone seeing this?

comments.body: Reverting to LKG of nov 22 to see if this solves the problem.

Disregard this issues, think I found the "problem":
Somehow WiFi was enable (always have it off by default)
